zh.title: 長榮航空預估明年貨運量維持良好成長 AI供應鏈出貨預估維持高檔至2027年
zh.summary: 長榮航空預估明年貨運量維持良好成長，AI供應鏈出貨預估維持高檔至2027年。
body: 長榮航空總經理孫嘉明預估，明年整體貨運量仍能維持良好成長。他表示，在臺灣AI伺服器出口量暴增帶動下，AI供應鏈到2027年仍會維持高出貨量；AI相關電子零組件供應鏈產品與醫藥冷鏈需求，也提供貨運市場支撐。
長榮航空前3季歸屬母公司淨利為新臺幣189.15億元，年增2.3%。今年前10月合併營收為新臺幣2,175.61億元，創歷年同期新高。
長榮航空指出，前3季貨運營收年增27%。孫嘉明另預估，明年首季客機運能增加3%，貨機運能增加0.3%。

en.title: EVA Air Expects Cargo Growth Next Year as AI Supply-Chain Shipments Stay High Through 2027
en.summary: EVA Air expects cargo growth next year, with AI supply-chain shipments remaining high through 2027.
body: EVA Air’s general manager expects overall cargo volume to maintain solid growth next year. He said a surge in Taiwan’s AI server exports is expected to keep AI supply-chain shipments high through 2027. Demand for AI-related electronics supply-chain products and pharmaceutical cold-chain services would also support the cargo market.

EVA Air reported net profit attributable to its parent of NT$18.915 billion for the first three quarters, up 2.3% year over year. Consolidated revenue for the first 10 months of the year was NT$217.561 billion, a record for the same period.

The airline said cargo revenue rose 27% in the first three quarters. Its general manager forecast passenger aircraft capacity would increase 3% in the first quarter next year, while freighter capacity would rise 0.3%.

zh.title: 美同意對烏克蘭提供 F-16 維保軍售方案 由歐洲四國出資
zh.summary: 美國國務院同意可能的 F-16 維保軍售，估值6.219億美元，由比利時、丹麥、荷蘭與挪威出資。
body: AeroTime 引述美國國務院11月25日的國會通知報導，美方同意一項可能向烏克蘭出售的 F-16 維保設備與服務方案，估值6.219億美元。
烏克蘭空軍表示，款項將由比利時、丹麥、荷蘭與挪威出資。美方通知指出，相關設備和服務將納入既有軍售案。公告金額屬估算，實際金額以後續安排為準。

en.title: U.S. clears possible F-16 sustainment sale to Ukraine with European funding
en.summary: Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway are to fund a possible U.S. sale estimated at $621.9 million.
body: The U.S. State Department cleared a possible sale of F-16 sustainment equipment and services to Ukraine, AeroTime reported, citing a November 25 congressional notification. The package has an estimated value of $621.9 million.

Ukraine’s Air Force said Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway would fund the purchase. The equipment and services would be added to an existing foreign military sales case. The announced figure is an estimate.

zh.title: 美國海軍增訂3架 E-130J 測試機
zh.summary: 美國海軍執行約11.3億美元的合約選擇權，使 E-130J 開發案的已訂測試機增至6架。
body: 美國海軍依既有合約執行選擇權，委託諾斯洛普格魯曼設計、開發並交付3架 E-130J Phoenix II 系統驗證測試機。11月25日公佈的合約修改價值約11.3億美元，另涵蓋初期備料。
AeroTime 報導，這筆訂單使該計畫所訂購的測試機增至6架。E-130J 是美國海軍的空中戰略通訊機開發計畫，本次公佈的是開發合約。

en.title: U.S. Navy orders three more E-130J test aircraft
en.summary: A $1.13 billion contract option brings the number of E-130J test aircraft under contract to six.
body: The U.S. Navy exercised an option under an existing Northrop Grumman contract to design, develop and deliver three E-130J Phoenix II system demonstration test aircraft. The contract modification, announced on November 25, is valued at about $1.13 billion and also covers initial spares.
AeroTime reported that the order brings the program’s total under contract to six test aircraft. The E-130J is an airborne strategic communications development program.

zh.title: 俄羅斯軍事法院裁定羈押空天軍副司令格列霍夫
zh.summary: 俄媒引述法院紀錄指出，負責裝備的空天軍副司令格列霍夫遭羈押。俄媒稱案件涉及收賄指控。
body: 俄羅斯《生意人報》查閱法院紀錄後報導，莫斯科第235衛戍軍事法院11月25日批准調查人員的聲請，裁定羈押俄羅斯空天軍負責裝備的副司令格列霍夫。
該報引述消息人士稱，格列霍夫面臨收賄指控。AeroTime 報導，格列霍夫否認指控。俄媒尚未交代據稱涉案的金額或與哪一項採購有關。

en.title: Russian military court orders detention of Aerospace Forces deputy chief Grekhov
en.summary: Russian media said a Moscow court ordered the deputy chief responsible for armaments held in connection with a bribery allegation.
body: Kommersant reported that Moscow’s 235th Garrison Military Court granted investigators’ request to hold Yuri Grekhov in pretrial detention on November 25. He is the Russian Aerospace Forces deputy commander-in-chief responsible for armaments.

The newspaper cited sources who said the case concerns alleged bribery. AeroTime reported that Grekhov denies the charge. The reports did not identify an alleged payment amount or link the case to a specific procurement contract.
